text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, yay. Ufufu. Thank you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I've got a present for you too~. I'll give 
it to you later♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, my, you prepared this specially for 
me? I'm so glad. I'll have to give you a 
little thank-you gift in return, too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, I was just thinking of baking a 
pie, you know~ Stuffed with gratin 
inside...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you really didn't need to thank me. 
...That being said, it looks so tasty~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Tran-san prefers something 
sweet. Apple, chocolate... blueberry... 
Hmm. What would Tran-san—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, hold on, hold on. Today is 
Accu-san's birthday, remember?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
A day to eat what you like and do what you 
love, Accu-san. And I'll be right there 
keeping you company.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Whatever I like...? I was just planning to 
relax and watch a period drama, but 
wouldn't that be boring for you?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No way! Don't go underestimating Tran-chan 
the informant!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'll find a super special time that can 
only be enjoyed with you, Accu-san~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, my, aren't you impressive. Ehehe. 
Thanks to you, this is going to be an even 
more fun birthday than usual, yes it is~.
